sections.passageTitle: Booking Online and Saving the Environment
sections.passageText:
When you are looking to book a holiday, it is unlikely that you will think about how green your booking decision is, but it is something that you should think about. By "green" we mean the impact on the environment.

When looking to book a holiday, you will probably find that you are faced with two main decisions. The first is to go into a travel agency, pick up brochure(宣传册), read through them and go back with just one and book with the travel agents directly or over the phone. The second is to go onto the Internet.

The Internet holds many advantages over the travel agencies. The main one is convenience. You can go online to look at holidays at any time of the day. The travel agents, however, are usually very busy at times when people can actually go, i.e. lunch hours or at the weekend. You could use the telephone but you wouldn't be able to see the pictures or the details of the holidays, so you would probably be sent a brochure anyway.

There are websites on the Internet that make shopping for holiday deals much easier. These websites are known as price comparison websites. They search through lots of different tour operators, and the results are displayed on one page, from which you can choose.

Compared with the travel agencies, booking online is greener. The piles of brochures are definitely not green, and the amount of unnecessary paper used can't be good for the environment. In the days of the Internet, there is really no need for such a large amount of paper to be wasted. So booking online will not only save you time and effort, it will do a little bit towards saving the environment, too!

questions.stem: When planning holidays, few people will think about being green.
questions.answerExplanation: 第一段说 it is unlikely that you will think about how green your booking decision is（人们不太可能考虑预订是否环保），与题干意思一致，故选A。

questions.answerExplanation: 第二段开头明确提到 two main decisions：去旅行社或上网预订，与题干一致，故选A。

questions.stem: People go to travel agencies and make their decisions directly.
questions.answerExplanation: 第二段说明去旅行社的人通常先拿宣传册通读后再挑一本回去，直接或通过电话与代理人预订，并非当场直接做决定，故选B。

questions.stem: The main advantage of booking online is saving money.
questions.answerExplanation: 第三段明确说网络预订最主要的优点是 convenience（方便），并非省钱，故选B。

questions.stem: Many people go to travel agencies at lunch time.
questions.answerExplanation: 第三段提到旅行社在人们实际能去的时间（如午饭时间或周末）通常很忙，可推断很多人在午饭时间去旅行社，故选A。

questions.stem: Booking holidays by telephone requires less communicative skills.
questions.answerExplanation: 第三段只提到电话预订看不到图片和详情，并未提及是否需要更少的交流技巧，文中未提及，故选C。

questions.stem: There are limited choices at price comparison websites.
questions.answerExplanation: 第四段说这些网站搜索了很多不同的旅行社（lots of different tour operators），选择并不有限，与题干相反，故选B。

questions.stem: Travel agencies make the best use of price comparison websites.
questions.answerExplanation: 全文没有提到旅行社会充分利用价格对比网站，文中未提及，故选C。

questions.stem: Travelers collect brochures as a hobby.
questions.answerExplanation: 文中并未提到旅行者以收集宣传册为爱好，文中未提及，故选C。

questions.stem: Booking online is a way to save the environment.
questions.answerExplanation: 最后一段明确说网络预订比去旅行社更绿色环保，是一种保护环境的方式，故选A。

sections.passageText:
Urban gardening refers to the practice of planting a garden the city. Apartments, town homes, and other areas with little or no land are being used for gardening. This method of gardening is becoming more common as the amount of land for gardening in cities is becoming smaller and smaller.

Containers, hanging baskets and raised beds are examples of items people use to create a garden in a confined space. Some cities also offer a shared community garden for people who have no room to grow plants at home.

Many types of plants can be grown in containers and baskets. Tomatoes and peppers, for instance, can grow in containers on windowsills(窗台). Plants grown on a windowsill should usually receive at least six to eight hours of sunlight daily. Herbs are often grown in containers or baskets in the kitchen. They do not require much space and can be handy for cooking.

People who want to grow more plants may use raised beds which are usually made of wood pieces and filled with a mixture of soil and fertilizers. They can be built on top of any hard surface, including roof tops. People like them because the beds often cost much less than most other methods of gardening.

Community gardening could be an option for anyone who does not have space for a garden at home. Most cities that offer this will rent a small plot and to someone for a fee, or allow them to use it free of charge Instead of dividing the and into separate plots, some cities allow everyone in the neighborhood to share and work on the same land. This method could be beneficial for people in the neighborhood who share the passion for growing things.

questions.stem: Urban gardening came into being as a result of ____.
options: A. the lack of land for gardening
questions.answerExplanation: 第一段说明城市中用于园艺的土地越来越少，因此出现了这种园艺方式，故选A。
confined 意为“狭窄的、有限制的”，与 limited 意思一致，故选C。

questions.answerExplanation: 第三段提到在窗台上种植的植物每天至少需要接收六到八小时的光照，故选D。

questions.answerExplanation: 第四段说人们喜欢种植床是因为它比大部分其他种植方法花费更少，故选B。

questions.answerExplanation: 最后一段说这种方式对社区中拥有共同种植热情的人有好处，可推断出它能让人们因共同爱好而联系起来，故选D。

sections.passageText:
①Usually when people decide to be teachers, they go to college, get a degree, and find a job at a school They prepare lesson plans, give out homework, and make up tests. To them, it is just a job, a way to make a living. But for my science teacher, Mrs. Cook, teaching is not just her b; it's who she is. She teaches through her heart.

②She has so much enthusiasm in her lessons. She is the one who goes out late at night to buy 10 pounds of sugar for our experiments. She brings in water from the nearby canal to make her point, and to make us remember the lesson. She makes think that each new fact could change our lives.

③Mrs. Cook wants all of us to do well in school. She tries to reach each student. She neither ignores the sleeping kid in the back, nor let the problem students alone. She shows special concern to slow students, and often helps them after school. None of us can slip away from her attention.

④Middle school is probably one of the hardest times of our lives. We change friends so often, and fight with our parents constantly. But Mrs. Cook has made this year so much better for us than it could have been. We know that if we had to turn to anybody, it would be her. And I'm not alone in feeling is way; she is a role model for our whole class.

⑤Science had never been my favorite subject. I had never borrowed science books. I had never performed experiments in my home. But this year, it's the science class that I don't mind waking up for, the test I don't mind taking. I have Mrs. Cook to thank for that. She has taught us so much more than just a single subject.

options: A. Mrs. Cook makes our school life easier.
B. I enjoy science class now.
C. Mrs. Cook cares about each student.
D. Mrs. Cook is strict with her students.
E. Mrs. Cook's lessons are well-prepared.
F. Teaching is more than a job for Mrs. Cook.

Do you know that if you miss out too much sleep you will die? It's true! If you stay awake for a long, long time, your brain and body will break down.

The unofficial world record for staying awake is 11 days, and it's held by Randy Gardner. ___(26)___ He also had help from TV, and radio reporters, a sleep researcher and a doctor.

What happened? ___(27)___ Then his brain started to lose sense. On day 4, he thought a street sign was really a person. Okay 6, he began to speak very slowly. On day 9, he couldn't finish sentences. On day 10, Randy thought he saw a forest in the next room. ___(28)___ Eventually, after he'd broken the world record, Randy was told to go to sleep. Experiments that keep people awake for dangerously long periods are always stopped before the patients break down.

Rats, however aren't so well cared for. ___(29)___ That's sooner than if they a been allowed to sleep out were given no food. They get really thin. But that's not because they stop eating-quite the opposite. Even though these rats are eating food, their bodies can't process it in the normal way. On top of that, their little bodies lose more heat than normal, which makes them weak. This means that they need more food to stay at a healthy temperature. ___(30)___

And that's what lack of sleep does for you.

options: A. In fact, he went a bit crazy.
B. Normally rats wouldn't catch a cold.
C. Towards the end, the health of these rats is failing.
D. When kept from sleeping, they die within three weeks.
E. Randy asked two of his friends to stop him falling asleep.
F. First of all, staying awake long made Randy bad-tempered.

Most words in a child's vocabulary come from everyday encounters with language. Children___(31)___ up language from books, media, are conversations.

You can increase your child's vocabulary and___(32)___ knowledge by having conversations with them. With babies, you've talk to them about what you're doing so they can begin to___(33)___ words with concept. As your baby begins to speak, start asking, "What's that?" when___(34)___ to objects or pictures. Elaborate on their___(35)___ answers as a way to have them listening to more words. "Yes, that is a banana! It's___(36)___ and smooth."

With young children, you can talk about the things you see in your___(37)___, on trips around town, or on televising These conversations help build a child's___(38)___ of his world. When reading, pause to ask questions on the story. Ask, "Why do you think he did that? or "What do you think going to happen___(39)___?" Tell your children stories from your own life, or about the day they were___(40)___. This helps develop their personal and cultural identity.

questions.answerExplanation: 句中缺少一个动词原形，可与up组成短语的有build up（增强）和pick up（获得），根据句意应是从书本等渠道“获得”语言而非“增强”语言，故选I（pick）。
官方仅给出答案，无详细解析。
空格处应为动词原形（begin to do），且需能与with搭配，表示“把文字和概念连接起来”，只有link符合，故选A。
when后面缺少一个-ing形式，pointing to（指向）比understanding更符合“指向物体或图片时问那是什么”的题意，故选H。
空格处应为修饰answers的形容词，意为把孩子简单的答案详细复述一遍以让他们听到更多单词，simple最符合题意，故选B。
空格处缺少修饰banana的形容词，yellow（黄色的）符合香蕉的特性，故选E。
空格处缺少名词，句意为“可以和孩子讨论在你的社区（neighborhood）中看到的事物”，故选D。
句意为“这些对话有助于建立孩子对世界的理解（understanding）”，故选G。
句意为“你认为接下来（next）将会发生什么”，故选L。
空格处缺少动词的过去分词形式，was/were born（出生）符合题意“讲述他们出生的那天”，故选J。

sections.passageText:
Getting water seems (seem) so easy for many people. You will be_____(41)(mistake) if you think there is an_____(42)(end) supply of water. In fact, the world has a water shortage. Seventy percent of the world is_____(43)(cover) in water. But most of it is salt water. Only a small_____(44)(percent) is fresh drinking water. Countries_____(45)(include) Spain, Italy and South Africa actually import water from countries such as the United States and Australia. _____(46)(surprising), 1.1 billion people on earth have difficulty_____(47)(get) clean drinking water. This global problem is predicted to get_____(48)(bad) as the atmosphere becomes warmer.

Every person in Britain_____(49)(use) about 150 litres of water a day. In some countries people only have 5 to 10 litres a day! They would be_____(50)(shock) to learn how we waste drinking water.

questions.answerExplanation: 空格处缺少一个形容词，与前面的will be搭配表示“你会是错误的”，be mistaken为固定用法，故填mistaken。
空格处于an之后、名词supply之前，应为形容词；根据句意（若认为水资源供应无穷无尽则你就错了），应填表示“无穷无尽的”的endless。
空格处应填动词的过去分词与is构成一般现在时的被动语态，表示“百分之七十的地球被水覆盖”，故填covered。
空格处作句子主语，缺少名词，故填percentage（百分比/部分）。
该句谓语动词是import，空格处应填非谓语动词形式；included表被动完成，including表主动进行，符合“包括西班牙、意大利、南非等国家”的题意，故填including。
空格处是逗号前单独出现、用来修饰整个句子的状语成分，应使用副词形式surprisingly（句首大写）。
have difficulty (in) doing sth是固定搭配，in可省略，故填getting。
句意为“随着大气变暖，这个全球性问题预计会变得更糟”，应使用比较级，故填worse。
该句缺少谓语动词，主语every person为第三人称单数，一般现在时应填uses。
该句谓语为would be，空格处应填表示状态的形容词，be shocked（感到震惊）为固定用法，故填shocked。

sections.writingPrompt: 某英文报社正在举办题为"An Unforgettable Holiday"的征文活动。请就此题目写一篇英文短文应征，内容包括：①哪一个假期令你难忘 ②为什么令你难忘。请根据所提供材料中的要求完成一篇100词左右的英文写作任务。

questions.stem: An Unforgettable Holiday：请写一篇100词左右的英文短文，说明哪一个假期令你难忘、为什么令你难忘。
questions.answerExplanation:
官方参考范文：

An Unforgettable Holiday

When it comes to an unforgettable holiday, everyone has his or her own idea. Some people like the Chinese New Year holiday, while others are interested in the winter holiday. From my point of view, I prefer the first one.

There are mainly two reasons for my view. On the one hand, it can help me keep fit. For example, I usually go to play basketball during the long holiday, which not only exercises my body but also improves my health. On the other hand, during the holiday, going out for fun can make me refreshed after a period of stressful working or studying and increase my study effectiveness very well.

In a word, I like the Chinese New Year holiday very much and benefit a lot from it.

（官方答案页只提供了这篇参考范文，没有额外的评分细则或要点表。）
